messages:
mike: Heads-up — I'm blocked on merging the SDK PR because the API change (service header tweak) landed but the runtime patch isn't rolled out to staging yet. Can someone from runtime / helm help coordinate a quick bump? :pray:

anya: Which SDK PR? link: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/832

mike: that one. SDK needs the new `X-Redwood-Client` header to be proxied by the runtime so tests pass. API PR is merged: https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/452

lee: I can take the runtime side. Quick questions: is this strictly a proxy header pass-through or are we mutating values?

mike: pass-through only. We added the header in API responses for tracing. Unit tests in sdk assert header present after roundtrip. No mutation.

sam: I can help with helm bump and canary. What's the desired chart version?

mike: runtime image already built with tag `sha-8f3d2a`. Need chart patch to pick it up: set `image.tag: "sha-8f3d2a"` and add `env.ADD_PROXY_HEADER=true` in deployment template.

lee: ok I'll make a tiny runtime PR and push image to staging registry. Will ping when docker push is done.

deploy-bot: [CI] build/runtime pushed: registry.staging.redwood/inference/runtime:sha-8f3d2a — success (:white_check_mark:)

lee: runtime PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1294 — includes the env flag and unit test. Needs one runtime approver and helm chart change in infra/helm/runtime-chart

sam: I'll open the chart bump PR to infra repo and request canary deploy for the next 1 hour window. Landing order: runtime PR -> infra helm bump -> SDK merge.

mike: sounds good. SDK is green locally but blocked on CI failing to see header until runtime is live in staging. Appreciate the order.

iris: quick note from QA — if you can, add a small smoke test asserting header present in staging e2e. I'll add it to the canary job so we don't regress.

lee: adding smoke test now in runtime PR. snippet: `curl -I $STAGING_URL | grep X-Redwood-Client`

sam: infra PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/709 — sets `image.tag: "sha-8f3d2a"` and increases canary replicas to 2. Requesting ops review from @sam & @anya for rollout window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

anya: ops acked. Can run canary at 16:30 PT for 1 hour.

deploy-bot: [deploy] canary started for runtime/sha-8f3d2a — 2026-03-18T16:30:12Z

lee: smoke test passed on canary, header is present. logs: `200 OK` + `X-Redwood-Client: raven-1234`

sam: canary healthy. Rolling to full staging now.

deploy-bot: [deploy] staged rollout complete — runtime:sha-8f3d2a (:rocket:)

mike: re-ran SDK CI against staging endpoint — all tests now pass. SDK PR ready for merge. @anya can you merge infra helm bump after runtime PR is green?

anya: infra merge done. infra/709 merged.

lee: runtime PR approved and merged. runtime/1294 merged.

mike: SDK merged. Thanks everyone — this unblocks the console change too (console PR will now rebase and drop the temporary header mock). :tada:

iris: QA will run the full regression suite in staging tomorrow morning. Let me know if we need a rollback plan.

sam: rollback plan: revert infra PR and runtime deploy — no DB schema changes, safe rollback. I'll keep the PR links on the incident channel in case.

mike: great. Closing the loop here. If any fallout, ping #eng-oncall. Thanks! :thumbsup:
